name: Platonic solids
description: Convex regular polyhedra. They are vertex, edge and face transitive and are the basis of archimedian, johnson and many more polyhedra

sections.Properties:
Vertex transitive
Edge transitive
Face transitive
sections.Derivatives:
Archimedian solids
Johnson solids
Kepler-Poinsot polyhedra
Uniform star polyhedra

trivia: 3 of the 5 platonic solids have been synthesized as [hydrocarbons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Platonic_hydrocarbon)
Plato used his solids as geometric representations of the four elements (tetrahedron, cube, octahedron, icosahedron) and the universe itself (dodecahedron)
Kepler roughly approximated the orbits of planets in the solar system by sequentially circumscribing a sphere around each solid and another solid around the sphere
